rationale: The new audit closely matches the working example: policy checks, version bounds, exceptions, and sorted JSON output. Guion’s implementation already covers those needs, and its measured result on the matching frozen case supports choosing it for this task.
trial_observation: The requested command exited successfully. Both implementations passed all 17 acceptance cases. Across 7 paired trials of the named lockfile-auditor case, including oracle-check time, median elapsed time was 0.015335s for Guion and 0.088270s for Python (Guion/Python ratio: 0.173).
